mapper.insert: INSERT INTO couple_invitations(inviter_id, code, expires_at, status) VALUES (#{inviterId}, #{code}, #{expiresAt}, #{status})
INSERT INTO couples (user_a_id, user_b_id, status, bound_at) VALUES (#{userAId}, #{userBId}, #{status}, #{boundAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE couple_invitations SET status = #{status} where code = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM couples WHERE (user_a_id = #{userId} OR user_b_id = #{userId}) AND status = #{status}
